active_phases.name: make the Aside prescription true: the repl surface over Bash, on a dedicated profile
active_phases.objective: Replace v36's three-surface taxonomy with the two that exist -- 'aside repl' (the Playwright-like surface, driven by the executor itself) and 'aside exec' (Aside's own model driving) -- and prescribe 'aside repl' over Bash as the default, explicitly NOT the MCP transport, recording the measured ~1,344-token-per-session cost as the reason and the listBrowserTabs()/attachBrowserTab() re-attach idiom as the canonical preamble. Name 'claude mcp add -s local aside -- aside mcp' as an optional per-operator escape hatch the workspace neither ships nor prescribes. Require agent Aside runs on a dedicated profile via 'aside --account <id>', never the operator's signed-in one, returning needs_operator when only the personal profile exists. Keep the Linux/CI fallback as written. Rewrite the 'not Playwright' argument as 'not a pre-written assertion suite'. Closes D9, D10, D11. Ships as workspace v37.

active_phases.name: close the workspace's context leaks, measured against live adopters
active_phases.objective: Measure where the workspace actually spends context across four live adopting repos (changple5 v36, changple_web v35, Mijual v36, arb_upbit_1 v35 -- ~1,140 slices, 83 archived phases between three of them), then close only the leaks the measurement justifies. Confirmed leak with an operator-proposed remedy to research first: per-review durable-doc consolidation rewrites whole docs that only grow (changple5 backend.md at v0054, 420 KB, rewritten by every review) -- research retiring doc-new-version from the review slice in favour of dedicated operator-created docs phases, and what a review still records if so. Open questions: whether the 16 KB phase.md budget is right (post-v35 notebooks ride within bytes of the ceiling -- is mid-phase compaction losing decisions under that pressure?); whether plan.md + result.md suffice as the orchestrator's post-slice record; what the review may read instead of every result.md; executor validation cost; where keep-tests-small needs teeth (changple5: 494 test files / 6.3 MB; the other three comply). Two suspects retracted by measurement: archiving works (rotate-backlog; 56/20/7 archived) and the notebook budget is respected since v35. DECOMP cuts a research slice first -- the fix list is not knowable before the measurement -- and DECOMP2 cuts the remedies from findings. Machinery and doctrine only: adopter repos are read as evidence and receive a documented procedure, never edits from here.

active_phases.name: make doc staleness explicit and right-size the notebook and test guardrails
active_phases.objective: Implement the operator's three resolved decisions from P21's deferred questions. (1) D14 -- no fixed docs-phase cadence: consolidation runs only when the operator wants it; in exchange every durable doc carries an explicit last-updated marker (source commit, date, consolidating phase -- in docs/index.json and surfaced where agents read docs), plus doctrine that a doc older than the owed Doc-impact notes is stale evidence, not truth. (2) D15 -- relax the phase-notebook budget to a soft ~100k-token cap (warning-only), replacing the 16 KB / 200-line squeeze that forced four P21 slices to compress; keep the finish-slice size printout. (3) D16 -- sharpen keep-tests-small: test files only for very core behavior, never style/cosmetic/trivial surface -- verified live instead. Machinery and doctrine in this repo only (adopters inherit via upgrade); close D14/D15/D16 when the phase passes.
